articles.title: Cats, Cryptids, And Questionable Life Choices Collide In This Artist’s 57 Comics
articles.description: Clar Hart, the artist behind Exploding Lobster Comics, has a talent for finding humor in the strange little thoughts, habits, and interactions that make everyday life so entertaining. Her comics move effortlessly from relatable observations and awkward moments to chaotic cats, bizarre creatures, and surprisingly adorable cryptids. With expressive characters, colorful artwork, and punchlines that often veer into the wonderfully absurd, Hart turns even the simplest situations into something memorable. We previously featured her Halloween-themed comics, but this collection shows off the much broader range of weirdness that makes Exploding Lobster so much fun. Scroll down to enjoy 57 of her comics and see which ones feel a little too relatable.
